overview: Nightmare in Suburbia is the shocking series that peers behind the lace curtains of suburban Britain to expose its dark, sinful and murderous underbelly. Come with us as we reveal that criminality is not only confined to big cities. In fact some of the most gruesome and unexpected crimes in the UK's recent history have taken place amongst the most unsuspecting and apparently innocent of communities.
title: Nightmare in Suburbia

overview: Two pop superfans go from besties to rivals when the chance to see their favorite group in Korea tests the limits between devotion and obsession.
title: Night Shift for Cuties

overview: Morpheus is the story of Piotr Leyer, a lawyer who, through an unfortunate turn of events, finds himself at the head of a gang. When young Leyer takes control of the organized crime group previously led by his brother—and before that, his father—it quickly becomes clear that he fits in surprisingly well with the underworld. The seemingly ordinary husband and father fulfills his new responsibilities with increasing effectiveness, slowly pushing the boundaries of morality one after another.
title: Morfeusz

overview: New York City-based comedian and YouTube creator Kareem Rahma launches a new series where the journey truly is the destination. In each episode, Rahma hops into a yellow cab and asks the driver to take him to their favorite place - with one condition: keep the meter running. What begins as a simple fare quickly evolves into a deep dive into the driver's world and a moving exploration of the American Dream, as Kareem asks the poignant questions he never had the chance to ask his own cabbie father. As the meter rises, each ride becomes a space for connection and storytelling, where Kareem learns about the lives of the people behind the wheel and ultimately discovers a little more about himself. "Keep the Meter Running" is produced by Rahmavision and AND Media. Kareem Rahma and Adam Faze serve as producers.
title: Keep The Meter Running

overview: A national treasure. A shocking trial. Rolf Harris: Primetime Predator exposes for the first time how celebrity, nostalgia and unchecked power shielded decades of abuse.
title: Rolf Harris: Primetime Predator

overview: It is a fake reality drama set against the backdrop of a luxury resort in Pattaya, Thailand, where eight young men and women engage in a love survival game that blurs the lines between sincerity and pretense, ideals and reality.
title: Adieu Solo

overview: Lot Patrol follows a mismatched squad of eccentric security guards as they patrol the chaotic backlot of a major Hollywood studio, wrangling unhinged actors, rogue crew members, and their own wildly dysfunctional personal lives.
title: Lot Patrol

overview: A new online sitcom about auditioning in New York City. Submissions Only follows a group of friends as they navigate the trips and falls, callbacks and trainwrecks experienced while working in this glorious business we call show.
title: Submissions Only
Da Bu Liao Liang Ban Dao

overview: Sex & Violence looks at the lives of professionals who work in the aftermath of domestic violence: a social worker, a victim advocate, a prosecutor, a police officer, and a therapist. The show chronicles their struggles to maintain healthy, intimate personal relationships while working daily with people caught in violent and dysfunctional lives. This original 6-hour mini-series stars Academy Award® winning actress Olympia Dukakis (Moonstruck, Tales of the City), Gemini winners Jennie Raymond (The Associates), Jackie Torrens (Made in Canada), Kerry Fox (Shallow Grave, An Angel at My Table), along with Canadian Idol alum Naomi-Joy Blackhall-Butler. Sex & Violence was shot on location in Nova Scotia. It was produced by Halifax's Emotion Pictures with Thom Fitzgerald (The Hanging Garden, Cloudburst) writing and directing.
title: Sex & Violence

overview: Told by key players who were inside the courtroom, this comprehensive documentary dissects the trial of Michael Jackson and his complex legacy.
title: Michael Jackson: The Verdict

overview: When rips in time called anomalies started opening across the UK, dangerous creatures from the past and future began appearing in the most unexpected places, endangering lives and placing the whole of humanity at risk. A crack team of specialists were appointed by the government to investigate and control "creature incursions," creating the Anomaly Research Center (ARC), which was later privatized. Matt, Abby, Connor and Becker do the field work while Jess mans the ARC control station under the leadership of government official James Lester and the mysterious scientist, Philip Burton
title: Primeval

overview: Los Angeles County Sheriff's Detective Stilwell has been "exiled" to a low-key post policing rustic Catalina Island. But while following up the usual drunk-and-disorderlies and petty thefts that come with his new territory, Stilwell gets a report of a body found weighed down at the bottom of the harbor.
title: Welcome to Catalina

overview: Forty years after being abandoned at a Barcelona train station, three siblings embark on a final quest to discover their identities and solve a mystery that remains unsolved.
title: Abandonados

overview: Ashley Johnson and Taliesin Jaffe reminisce about their weird days as child actors and discuss all the eclectic things that have made and continue to make this world more fun.
title: Weird Kids

overview: Defne, who climbed the career ladder with her own efforts in her 30s, has always built her life on her own feet, as her mother taught her. Defne, who is strong, controlled and does not give up the order she is used to, one day realizes how tired and lonely she actually is. Maybe it's time to truly fall in love for the first time in your life. However, the two men he encounters will turn everything upside down. Nothing will ever be the same for Defne, who is caught between Kadir's direct and shocking attitude and Tolga's games that change the balance. Misunderstandings, jealousies, challenges and an attraction that grows as you escape; It will draw the audience into a passionate love story.
title: Muhtemel Aşk

overview: Attitude has partnered with Channel 4 to launch a digital series tied to Russell T Davies' new drama Tip Toe, which launched on Channel 4 on 31 May. Titled Tip Toe or Ta-Da, guests including Danny Beard, Charley Marlow, Jason Patel and Jaxon Feeley unpack the programme's themes in honest and raw conversations, filmed in the Canal Street bar that serves as the real-world setting in Tip Toe itself.
title: Tip Toe or Ta-Da

overview: The inside story of a vote that divided a nation. Unravelling the rivalries, betrayals and conflicts that tore apart the campaigns, told by those at the heart of Leave and Remain.
title: Brexit: A Very British Civil War

overview: Relive the biggest events of Australian Motorsport history in Seven's new program Shannons Legends of Motorsport, hosted by Neil Crompton and launching on 7mate on Saturday July 19th. In an entertaining 12 part series Neil Crompton, Australia's premier motoring commentator brings to life the history of Australian Motorsport with rarely seen historical footage from Seven's extensive archives dating from the '60's to the '90's.
title: Shannons Legends of Motorsport

overview: Young Demon Lord Wei Jie is taken in as the unlucky disciple of Cui Xiaoxiao, a disaster-prone sect leader cursed with ten misfortunes. A journey back 200 years brings two people from the wrong timeline together at the right moment. From constantly teasing and saving each other to risking their lives side by side, they eventually join forces to expose a divine conspiracy, rewrite fate, and protect the world.
title: To Defy the Stars

overview: After embroidery house owner Wu Lian ruins countless lives of the female embroiderers in his climb to power, Lin Rulan, one of the embroiderers, survives a tragic betrayal while her loyal friend Meng Wan spends three years plotting in silence. Joined by survivors and unlikely allies, they launch a ruthless takedown of the corrupt elite and fight for justice
title: The Embroidered Truth

overview: Lin You, a freshly released juvenile offender with an unusually strong fate, stumbles into the "Daji Agency" and lands a job as a haunted-house tester. Teaming up with Xu Liuliu, a girl with special heterochromatic eyes, they unravel one mystery after another. Each "ghostly" case hides a shocking human twist beneath the surface. Through their comics, they help lingering souls find peace or break their own inner demons, walking the line between yin and yang to achieve their own redemption.
title: The Found Family

overview: Modern doctor Li Yunhe transmigrates as a despised son-in-law. Using his modern medical knowledge, he revives the lost royal silk, outwits rivals, and dazzles the court at a grand fashion event. After crushing a rebellion, he rises from obscurity to legendary status.
title: The Silk Master from the Future

overview: A visionary man Xerxes Desai with his team turns humiliation into history by building India's first world-class watch brand, proving that time itself can be reclaimed through courage, failure, and innovation.
title: Made In India: A Titan Story

overview: Deputy Captain Li Kaiyang of the major crimes unit teams up with his reluctant apprentice Jiang Han to crack a series of sexual assault cases and a bizarre naked-body murder. But then a falling-death case emerges, and the supposedly gunned-down "Red Gloves" mysteriously returns to life, unleashing more horrors. Piece by piece, a decades-old puzzle comes together, thanks to the master-and-apprentice duo's relentless sacrifice.
title: The Murder Puzzle

overview: Driven by a blood feud, Deathsworn Mei Lin enters a lethal game for the throne. She is the mad prince's favorite weapon, a stand-in for a cruel heir's forgotten dream, and the obsessive object of a hostage prince's fierce devotion. As desire and deception collide in the imperial court, unfolds as a brutal, poignant spectacle of love and betrayal.
title: Blooms for Her

overview: Jiang Tian Cai, a gifted but aloof maxillofacial surgeon, suffers a major setback in his life and starts anew at a dental hospital in a small coastal town. In the confines of his clinic, he shows unwavering dedication to his profession and learns empathy while protecting patients' oral health.
title: Call For Dr. Jiang

overview: Twenty years behind bars for a crime he didn't commit. Liang Zhiqiang, once the deadliest enforcer of the Heyi Syndicate, returns to find his sworn buddy Xie Guanhong now rules the underworld and has married his ex-lover Zheng Baojiao. Liang tries to go straight, finding solace in a flower shop and a new love with a teacher, Danni. But the old world drags him back through shadows of past crimes, shifting loyalties, and a truth that shatters everything. He learns that the underworld never forgets. This time, he bets it all, not for brotherhood, but for the people he truly cares about.
title: Portland Street Operation

overview: Top lawyer Su Yan, now thirty, lives by one rule: love yourself first, at least eighty percent. Abused by her mentor, neglected by her family, and cheated on by her fiancé, she has sworn off letting anyone close. Then Cheng Lin reappears. At nineteen, he is no longer the boy she once helped at a juvenile detention center. For five years, he has never stopped loving her. His return forces her to face the wounds she has buried. Together, they heal each other, piece by piece, and slowly remember what it means to trust, to risk, and to love again.
title: The One

overview: Jiang Yukui, the Holy Maiden of the Zhao Tribe, survives a childhood of captivity and embarks on a quest for revenge after learning of her sister's death. Armed with divine powers and drawn into the orbit of the formidable Feng Ye, she finds an unexpected ally and love while battling a tyrant emperor and his ruthless empress. But when Yukui discovers her sister is alive and the true mastermind behind a years-long scheme to seize power, a deadly game of twin deception begins. As love and vengeance collide, destiny leads them toward the day the camellias finally bloom.
title: Camellias

overview: Framed and jailed for four years, Ren Feifan, heir of the renowned Kui Medical Hall, returns to North City to uncover the conspiracy that destroyed his family, expose the culprit behind Wang's Pharmaceutical, and revive his heritage against foreign threats to traditional Chinese medicine. Reunited with his ex-fiancée Xu Ruojin, the two slowly reconnect. Standing together through crisis and chaos, they rebuild trust, support each other, and face the future side by side.
title: I Am Fei Fan

overview: This is the blood-soaked tale across three lifetimes of Mu Ruyi, Princess of Xiling, and Ling Xiao, Prince of Dongqing. She saved his life, but he returned with vengeance. Their wedding was stained in blood, love and hate intertwined. She faked her death and returned as a shadow, seeking retribution. He drowned in his own obsession, unable to rise, bound by the heart-blood and the oblivion herb. In the end, their love and hate were bound together by fate. Three lifetimes of glances. Is it fate? Or Misfortune? In the end, it was just three acts they played alongside each other in this life! Adapted from "Endless Love", the song of the same name by Hailai Amu.
title: Endless Love

overview: What began as a chance encounter between German-Brazilian interpreter Silvia Sommerlath and Sweden's young Crown Prince Carl Gustaf at the 1972 Olympic Games in Munich turned into one of Europe's most iconic royal love stories.
title: Queen Silvia

overview: TV Week Logie Award winner The Living Room is back, with Amanda Keller and co-hosts Chris Brown, Miguel Maestre and Barry Du Bois returning to spice up Friday nights on TEN.
title: The Living Room

overview: Two people have loved each other in past lives, and that love is represented in a sun-shaped medallion that splits in half, and if the couple does not reunite it will have a tragic end.
title: La otra mitad del sol

overview: Upon dying suddenly, Pedro José Donoso discovers that he was betrayed and murdered and is reincarnated as a young and attractive peasant named Salvador Cerinza to take revenge.
title: En cuerpo ajeno

overview: Six university students are assigned to do their internships in El Difícil, a small Colombian town in the middle of the conflict between the army, the guerrillas and the paramilitaries.
title: Tiempos difíciles

overview: Some choices bring happiness, while others change lives forever. Get ready for an emotional journey filled with love, dreams, and unexpected twists.
title: Intekhab

overview: In this new reality show, 12 well-known Dutch and Flemish celebrities live together with the Himba community in Namibia. This means the participants must live without modern amenities and adapt to the tribe's way of life. The participants are judged on their effort and their respect for the culture. The celebrities who are least able to adapt are eliminated. Ultimately, only one participant remains. This person is named an honorary member by the community.
title: Ticket to the tribes

overview: Two roommates find their friendship tested by unspoken feelings during a road trip in this "light, refreshing and entertaining" rom-com hailed by Woman.
title: Toda la verdad de mis mentiras

overview: Kitchen Chaos will dive headfirst into the wild, unpredictable world of food with viral moments of jaw-dropping culinary triumphs and spectacular meltdowns, from hibachi tricks gone wildly off the rails to bizarre and unhinged food recipes that must be seen to be believed. Along the way, professional chefs deliver hilarious reactions, insider tips, and practical takeaways that reveal what went wrong, what went right, and how to avoid culinary chaos at home. It's a fast, flavor-packed ride through the creativity, chaos, and comedy of food culture.
title: Kitchen Chaos

overview: Pitmasters is a raw, relentless, real-world BBQ competition unlike anything ever attempted on Food Network. A non-stop week-long battle set deep in the wilderness where teams of the most notable pitmasters will push the boundaries of what BBQ can be as they compete over live fire to prove they are the best of the best. They will be cooking from sunrise to sunset to sunrise again, fighting for survival and their share of up to $50,000 in prize money. Teams must manage fire, fatigue, and challenges within challenges to impress an elite panel of judges.
title: Pitmasters

overview: Kitchen Undercover, a high-stakes, sneak-attack restaurant rescue, led by chef Antonia Lofaso, alongside sous-chef Nestor Milian who will go full undercover, slipping into failing restaurants that are one more bad review away from total collapse. While Antonia watches the drama unfold from a secret command center— spying on every meltdown, mistake, and questionable choice—Nestor will be on the inside, embedded with the staff, stirring the pot and digging up the juicy truth. From toxic team dynamics to tragic food, nothing will stay hidden for long. When the real reasons customers aren't coming back are exposed, Antonia will storm in to shake things up, call out the chaos and whip these teams into shape. But with the clock ticking and closure looming, only time will tell if Antonia can turn these hot messes into hot spots.
title: Kitchen Undercover
Gui Bu Yu Zhi Po Xiao

overview: The Pyramid Scheme follows the story of Goldy, an ambitious but impatient young man, whose quest to get rich through a pyramid marketing business spirals into a rollercoaster of chaos - risking not just his future, but also the love and trust of his close-knit joint family.
title: The Pyramid Scheme

overview: The Marriage Plot follows three recent college graduates caught in an all-consuming love triangle as they reconcile their youthful romantic aspirations with looming adulthood and make life-altering choices about love and identity.
title: The Marriage Plot

overview: In the aftermath of a devastating home invasion, Alice Rathbone refuses to accept that the tragic event was simply random. Desperate for answers, Alice starts pulling at threads and soon finds a trail of dark secrets that spiral closer to home than she could ever have imagined.
title: The Break-In

overview: Fumihara Ichiro and Higashi Kei are colleagues whose relationship began through a shared love of movies. While Kei admires Ichiro as both a mentor and a supervisor, neither expects their growing bond to develop into something more. Haunted by past trauma, Ichiro has long avoided deep connections, believing he could never share his life with someone else. Kei, meanwhile, has never experienced romantic attraction and considers himself someone untouched by love. After Ichiro confesses that he is gay, the two eventually begin a relationship. One year later, however, Ichiro is still plagued by doubts. Twelve years older than Kei and unable to understand why someone like him would choose to be with him, he questions whether Kei's feelings are truly romantic. As they confront their insecurities and learn what love means to them, the two must discover whether the life they are building together can become the ordinary love they have both been searching for.
title: Ordinary Love

overview: At the peak of his career, top celebrity Feng Qinglang escapes to a remote tea mountain, seeking a brief respite from the spotlight. Instead, he meets Xu Changyang, a free-spirited young tea farmer with an untamed soul. One belongs to the dazzling world of fame, the other to the forests and the land. As they grow closer among the mountains and wilderness, love quietly takes root. But the relentless scrutiny of the entertainment industry and the harsh realities of society soon close in, pushing them toward separation time and again. In the end, will they follow the call of their hearts and risk everything for love?
title: A Winter Sun Wakes the Wind in Spring Hills' Dream

overview: Ji Han, the grim reaper who manages death, receives a list of names and descends to the human world again today. School, unfamiliar scenery, and a strange self. But the task seemed simple: he simply needed to find the target of the code floating above his head. But the code written on the register hovered over two people simultaneously. One was Hyeon Jun, with his indifferent gaze, the other Yung Hui, with his playful smile. The question, "Who should die?" soon morphed into "Who should live?" and Ji Han, hiding his identity, began living as a student alongside the two.
title: Fix the Error!

overview: Patrick Huard invites three artist friends, each accompanied by someone close to them, to push their limits and face their greatest fears in Celebrity Fear Factor. In each episode, the pairs try to avoid elimination by overcoming three challenges that are as spectacular as they are terrifying. At the end, the winning duo donates $5,000 to the charity of their choice.
title: Fear Factor Célébrités

overview: Ilia Topuria is one of the biggest stars in MMA. A documentary that explores his personal side and reveals a side of the champion never seen before.
title: Los Topuria

overview: Maybe famous… or maybe not yet. Disband the group?! No way!!! Once an idol group with dreams of stardom, they're now forced to wear mascots and sing children's songs for kindergarten kids. Humiliating? Absolutely. "But boss… even that song was successful." "3,500 views?! That's your definition of success?" Everyone quits. Everyone—except Jeng (Dome Phemadech), the only one who stays beside Boss Sithian (Aomstin Thakrit).
title: Lost to Light

overview: A human mystery centered around a set of 200-year-old human remains discovered in the Himalayas, whose DNA perfectly matches that of a missing sister-in-law.
title: Labyrinth of Hortensia and the Minotaur
Houkago wa mystery to tomo ni

overview: In 1995, 18 minutes of grainy film shocked the world and sparked one of the most compelling mysteries of our time. The so-called ‘Alien Autopsy' footage appeared to show three government officials in hazmat suits dissecting the corpse of an alien recovered from a crash-site near Roswell, New Mexico in 1947. The footage became an international sensation, captivating film experts, military analysts, and even the Secret Service. But the question remained: was it genuine, or an elaborate hoax? The truth is far from straight forward. From director John Dower, this stranger-than-fiction documentary series follows members of an ambitious group of filmmakers who found themselves at the centre of an unprecedented media storm after re-creating a landmark alien encounter in a North London apartment, with some still insisting it was based on a genuine film recorded by the US military. As debates over extraterrestrial life reach the highest levels of the U.S. government, with military whistleblowers testifying to encounters with unidentified aerial phenomena, the series ventures deep into the wider world of ufology and the impact of Alien Autopsy. From Roswell's enduring origin myth to the mysterious Calvine sighting in Scotland, it explores the stories, sightings, and scraps of evidence that continue to divide believers and sceptics alike.
title: The Alien Autopsy Scandal

overview: Rental Love Lab: A Trial of Love "Love Lab" is a jack-of-all-trades shop ready to handle any job for its clients. "Claire," a feisty female employee, is tasked with taking care of "Eris," a famous mystery novelist. Eris needs someone to recreate "love scenes" for her new novel. From a crazy scene reenactment, the distance between the two gradually widens. When one person has never understood "love," and the other has never believed in it, this experiment… might unexpectedly become a real feeling.
title: Rental Love Lab

overview: A story about a shattered dream, an unlikely meeting, and the beginning of something neither of them saw coming.
title: Tera Banna Chala Hoon

overview: Can a "Blackout" save a boring romance? Set in the romantic streets of Lijiang, Yunnan, the story follows a couple who have lost their spark. They traveled to this ancient city hoping to relive the magic of their first "romantic encounter," but the feelings just wouldn't come back. However, everything changes after a night of heavy drinking and a total blackout. They meet a mysterious new boy—a real "adventure" they never expected! What happens when "Fresh Blood" enters the mix?
title: Blackout

overview: "They just don't make things the way they used to!" That's a common phrase uttered by many people, usually, when reminiscing about the care and love put into products and crafts in years past. Well, it turns out, there are lots of folks who make things "the way they used to," and INSP is out to discover the people who do it! From Seattle, Washington to Spruce Pine, North Carolina and big cities and small towns in between, Handcrafted America host Jill Wagner hits the road, traveling the country to seek out talented artisans who continue to make products the traditional way…with their own two hands, creating, sought-after contemporary classics. You'll meet a bladesmith, glassblower, blacksmith, bicycle maker and many other fascinating people from all across America who are dedicated to their crafts. In every half‐hour episode, Jill meets three gifted craftsmen, and she takes you on a behind‐the‐scenes look at how they create their products, from start to finish. Along the way, you'll delve into the history and cultural heritage that inspire and influence the design of their handcrafted products. You'll become a part of their lives as they tell the stories of their families, their journeys and their dreams. Known for her work as co-host of the reality show "Wipeout," and acting roles in "Teen Wolf" and "Christmas in the Smokies," host Jill Wagner's easy-going style brings out the best in people. Down to earth, witty and personable, she has a way of building a comfortable, honest and fun relationship with these extraordinary American artisans. So put your feet up; grab a snack. Enjoy a little bit of history, intriguing information and spontaneous adventure in every episode on this unique tour of America—from right in your own living room.
title: Handcrafted America

overview: In Columbus, Ohio, power flipper Tommy Harr and his family have built a business on seeing opportunity where others see disaster. Their edge comes from within the family — two generations of elite home inspectors, a fearless construction crew led by his middle brother, and a mom who doubles as both designer and real estate agent. Together, they take on the city's worst "zombie" houses, transforming rundown properties into stunning dream homes.
title: Zombie House Flipping: Family Business

overview: Sponsored content made in collaboration with American Family Insurance. Three teams of home design innovators face off against the worst Mother Nature has to offer to see whose build is truly designed to last. Part competition, part science experiment, each episode tests a different element—until one team reigns supreme and wins the $100,000 prize.
title: Designed To Last
